semantic_roles.background: White canvas with pale gray radial/grid guides and black outer spine.
semantic_roles.contrast_and_emphasis: High-contrast year outlines remain visible through translucent fills; dark bubbles remain legible against white outer space.
semantic_roles.roles_and_proportions: Navy, red, and orange encode the three years; dark blue bubbles encode planting area independently of year; black/gray text and guides provide structure.

marker_family.axes_and_scales: Polar angular categorical axis with radial linear ticks at 2000, 4000, and 6000.
marker_family.guides_and_grid: Circular radial grid and faint spokes support reading; dark circular spine frames the plot.
marker_family.marks_and_encoding: Polar filled polygons and vertices encode yearly grain yield; bubble area encodes planting area; radial position encodes magnitude.

annotations_typography.callouts_and_leaders: No leader callouts; radial spokes and tick labels provide the coordinate system.
annotations_typography.placement_and_clearance: Labels sit just outside the polar spine; center title is isolated in the donut; legends stay outside the polar data region.
annotations_typography.text_hierarchy: Small outer category labels, medium radial tick labels, and a centered multi-line Grain Yield title.

canvas_composition.alignment_and_spacing: Thirty radial categories evenly spaced around the circle; center donut clears the innermost data; right legends align vertically outside the polar axes.
canvas_composition.aspect_and_panel_layout: Large circular polar panel occupying the left/center of a square canvas, with two legends in the right margin and a small explanatory note below.
canvas_composition.visual_hierarchy: Filled yearly radar polygons and the white center donut are primary; outer bubble ring is a secondary quantitative layer; radial labels and legends support decoding.

chart_marks_axes.axes_and_scales: Polar angular categorical axis with radial linear ticks at 2000, 4000, and 6000.
chart_marks_axes.guides_and_grid: Circular radial grid and faint spokes support reading; dark circular spine frames the plot.
chart_marks_axes.marks_and_encoding: Polar filled polygons and vertices encode yearly grain yield; bubble area encodes planting area; radial position encodes magnitude.

legend_key.entries_and_encoding: Year legend uses colored swatches; planting-area legend uses three differently sized bubbles.
legend_key.frame_treatment: No visible frames; clean text-and-key layout.
legend_key.placement: Right of the polar panel, vertically separated by semantic role.
legend_key.scope: Two global legends: one for year colors and one for planting-area bubble size.

must_match: Filled overlapping polar polygons for three years
Outer ring of bubble marks encoding a second variable
White central donut with centered Grain Yield label
Dense radial category labels and circular grid
Separate year and bubble-size legends outside the polar panel

objects_material.depth_cues: Transparency and overlap create layered depth without gradients; bubble size supplies a second quantitative channel.
objects_material.fill_and_material: Year polygons use translucent fills to reveal overlap; bubbles use opaque/semi-transparent dark blue fills; center is white.
objects_material.outline_and_edges: Colored polygon outlines and a dark polar spine define the outer boundary; bubble edges are light for separation.
objects_material.placement_and_scale: Year polygons occupy the inner radial field; planting-area bubbles sit near the outer radius; donut is centered at the origin.
objects_material.shape_and_projection: Filled semi-transparent closed polygons on a polar coordinate system, with circular bubble marks around the outer ring and a central circular donut.

palette_roles.background: White canvas with pale gray radial/grid guides and black outer spine.
palette_roles.contrast_and_emphasis: High-contrast year outlines remain visible through translucent fills; dark bubbles remain legible against white outer space.
palette_roles.roles_and_proportions: Navy, red, and orange encode the three years; dark blue bubbles encode planting area independently of year; black/gray text and guides provide structure.

repetition_structures.count_spacing_rhythm: Dense, regular angular rhythm across all province/category labels.
repetition_structures.grouping_and_alignment: Each angle aligns year vertices, radial guides, labels, and one bubble mark.
repetition_structures.topology: Many evenly spaced radial categories repeat the same three yearly values plus one outer bubble.
repetition_structures.variation_and_emphasis: Year colors distinguish temporal series; bubble area varies by planting area; the central donut interrupts the dense center.
